observations: The wheel contains one stripped abi3 native extension and no Python runtime dependencies.
PyPI publish provenance binds the x86-64 wheel digest to firecrawl/anydoc release.yml at the v0.2.4 source commit.
The upstream repository and Python package declare MIT; the copied corpus remains under that license.
pip-audit 2.10.0 reported no known Python-package vulnerabilities on 2026-09-03.
The wheel does not carry a component SBOM, so the Rust transitive dependency inventory and vulnerability result must be regenerated from upstream Cargo.lock before production adoption.
